description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

BAE Systems is hiring an Entry Level Software Engineer to develop high-quality software for military electronic systems, including software-defined radios, avionics, and electronic warfare systems. The role collaborates across software, systems, and hardware teams throughout the product development lifecycle and offers project rotations, mentorship, and training through the Year One program.
Entry-Level Software Engineer developing and testing software solutions, integrating product validation tools, and improving software testability and throughput

Responsibilities:
• Designing, developing and testing software solutions utilizing Agile methodologies and sound software engineering principles while conforming to existing code development strategies and processes
• Assisting in other software engineering activities such as integration testing, algorithm & data analysis, software troubleshooting, and preparing documentation in accordance with established procedures
• Utilizing either Windows or Linux based software development environment and either x86 or PowerPC target and test environment
• Developing and maintaining the SW test solutions to improve product testability while increasing yield throughout the test process. Integrating software solutions to validate and tune products, provide training to technicians in the art of troubleshooting and work to optimize throughput

Requirements:
• Bachelor's degree in CS (Computer Science), CE (Computer Engineering), or other Scientific degree with suitable software engineering content
• 0-3 years professional software development experience
• Software coding utilizing modern programming languages (e.g. C++, C#, Java, etc.)
• Object oriented design/development
• Windows/Linux/Unix OS
• Must be eligible for a US DoW security clearance

Preferred:
• Real-time embedded development or other hardware-related skills
• Experience with the entire product life cycle development or parts of it: requirements review, test plan creation, coding, and integration
• Experience with EW systems
• Experience with SW version control and bug tracking tools (Git, Bitbucket, Jira, etc.)
• Security clearance (Secret or higher)
